title: Complianz banner keeps the old cookie policy link after the page setting changes
symptoms: Banner still links the old URL after saving the new page
cause: Complianz caches its link set in its own option-backed store cmplz_transients under keys such as page_links_1_en_US, and caches missing documents as "none".
fix: Delete those keys and let Complianz rebuild them, for example from a temporary admin-only snippet.
